metadata.overview: A home-mining space heater (or a Bitaxe) that speaks the AxeOS HTTP API. Its heat warms a room; its hashrate is sold as TiH through a Hashu mint. setupPools moves the hashrate between the owner's home pool and the Hashu proxy while a redemption is being filled.

telemetry.name: power
telemetry.description: Power draw, which is also the heat output.

telemetry.name: room_temperature
telemetry.description: Room temperature from the heater's ambient sensor; null when the device has none.

telemetry.name: power_mode
telemetry.description: Heat level: sleep, eco, normal or high.

commands.name: setupPools
commands.description: Point the miner at a pool and restart its stratum session. Takes pools: [{ url, user, pass }]; the first entry is used.

commands.name: setPowerMode
commands.description: Set the heat level: sleep, eco, normal or high.

commands.name: reboot
commands.constraints: Do not call more than once per 5 minutes.

errors.ERR_BAD_POOL: The pool must be stratum+tcp://host:port with a user.
errors.ERR_DEVICE_CALL_FAILED: The device's HTTP API call failed or returned an error.
